headline: Added settings to toggle off the QuickFind integration and BetterBags Next's vendor and guild bank windows.

entries.title: Toggles for Next vendor and guild bank windows
entries.details: New options under General > Bags allow you to disable BetterBags Next's custom merchant and guild bank interfaces to use Blizzard's default windows instead. The change takes effect immediately without a reload. When the custom vendor is turned off, categories configured to confirm Auto Sell can be sold by right-clicking their title.

entries.title: Toggle for QuickFind integration
entries.details: A new setting under Integrations > QuickFind allows you to turn off the integration immediately without needing to uninstall the QuickFind addon.
